t: A stop motion animation app for Mac, iPad, and iPhone with step by step guidance.
steps: Buy the app from the App Store, or ask IT to buy classroom licenses through Apple School Manager.
Check that devices run macOS 11 or later, or iOS 11 or later.
Connect a camera, a USB webcam, or the free Remote Camera app.
Take a test shot and turn on onion skin layers.
Shoot ten frames and play them back.
Import a sound and use the waveform to time the action.
Export a short GIF or video and save it to a class folder.
